sloka: वनं यदाभिपन्नास्ते साधितं कर्म वानरैः ।दृष्टा देवी न सन्देहो न चान्येन हनूमता ।न ह्यन्यः साधने हेतुः कर्मणो ऽस्य हनूमतः ।। ५.६३.१८ ।।।।
transliteration: vanaṁ yadābhipannāste sādhitaṁ karma vānaraiḥ ।dṛṣṭā devī na sandeho na cānyena hanūmatā ।na hyanyaḥ sādhane hetuḥ karmaṇo 'sya hanūmataḥ ।। 5.63.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hanuman alone has the ability to do it, the reason being he has the capacity the wisdom, streneous effort, virility and enthusiasm to accomplish it. These attributes are wellestablished in him.
translations.hindi: ग्रौर त्रिदा हो अपने घर को चला गया । तुम इस प्रकार के श्रस्त्रों के जानने वाले, पराक्रमी और शीलवान होकर भी
